reference: Root GPU review of authored-lawn detail/contact/both: continuous short green cover, but leaves read as wide angular glossy ribbons. The source photograph supports a short continuous lawn, not measured dimensions or species.

commonGeometry.units: metres; no inherited production template scale
commonGeometry.crossSection: smooth shallow quadratic fold, transported along a curved centreline; shared smooth normals, no two rigid panels
commonGeometry.tipFamilies: narrow intact tip and slightly oblique cut tip; cut tips remain narrow, never the previous half-width square paddle
commonGeometry.rootPositions: small irregular basal cluster with deterministic per-leaf variation, not identical golden-angle fans
commonGeometry.uv: existing three original photographed green tracks; barycentric/row interpolation only, original RGB/alpha/normal/roughness pixels unchanged
commonGeometry.normalPolicy: finite normalized smooth vertex normals, winding and tangent-space audit against actual renderer convention

variants.purpose: mixed leaf heights within the same maintained lawn
occasional older leaves, not a separate invented vegetation zone

materialControlledForAB.roughness: original ARM green; no newly invented global gloss suppression
materialControlledForAB.transmittedColour: same original diffuse atlas; no double IBL albedo tint

auditRequirements: Before/after SHA256 of original source master, all photographed channels and retained authored-v1 files
Deterministic buffers and per-leaf manifest; no repeated maximum-height lock across all variants
Actual per-leaf length, width, cut/taper counts, vertex groups and material links; declared ranges must match exported geometry
Finite vertices and normalized normals; nonzero triangle areas; positive face/vertex normal agreement; no UV outside original selected photographed leaf bands
Root min Y -0.002m, no exaggerated width at tips, no generated pixels or broad material recolouring
Actual Babylon RH projection of bed anchors, including camera rotation and CSS/internal resolution changes; labels cannot be hardcoded left/right
A/B camera/light/wind/scatter seed identical, then review each variant alone and a mixed patch at normal standing camera height, near contact, 6m and night
Original highest remains editable and immutable after separate distance LOD derivation; compare centreline/silhouette displacement and UV error
Runtime deployment must use world-metre geometry, existing source-backed grass exclusions and terrain sampler, not old point.size 0.09..0.19 template scaling
Full-game path/road edge/terrain/seam and alpha-shadow checks plus bounded draw/instance/texture budgets; no FPS claim from the component scene
limitations: All dimensions and mowing proportions are explicit artistic interpretation; no botanical or survey claim
5 cross-section vertices double the highest A/B triangle count to 5376 per three masters, roughly 6.28M potential triangles for the old 3500-instance study; this is not a production budget
Narrower leaves may expose more ground at the identical seed/density; measure and review this instead of silently increasing density
Four decoded 8k maps are not suitable as an assumed full-world runtime budget; source master remains 8k, runtime may use official lower-resolution originals and their GPU mips after visual review

Existing production placement proposes roughly one clump per square metre; directly replacing its normalized clump with this 3–6cm tuft would remain sparse. Near-surface coverage and bounded tile sampling need explicit integration work
No Blender, GPU, runtime edits or generator execution before worktree paths and coordinated permission are supplied
